Both Bruce Barton and Matt Hillier were nervous at finding themselves in exalted company in the steeplechase but both ran magnificently to personal records and in Matt's case, after this half minute improvement, getting him to within sight of our U20M Club Record of 9:32.5 set nearly ten years ago by Simon Maynard.
